items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: So Cab and me was like this. That they don't like. Some of the guys didn't like. (Inaudible) you always with Bauza, you know, (inaudible) drummer, say, I don't know what you call it, but I mean this man is the leader. He pay me.

ctx.x: So he uses one (inaudible), say, you (inaudible). So right after the show I came to the dressing room. He say -- I said, Cab, I hate to tell you this, man, but what I didn't want to happen just happened today. And this, the first time I (inaudible) the last time I go (inaudible). So you take my notice? Oh, yeah, I take your notice. Okay.

Same thing happened. Everybody here said, man, you crazy. Where you going, man? You leave the best job. I said, I don't care. I want a band with dignity. That's all. Say, look, I know how to work. I'm a musician. I know how music is supposed to be played. I don't have to take something like that. (Inaudible). Well, don't worry about it. Well, all right.
